items.title: Fachgebietsleitung (m/w/d) Tierarzneimittelzulassung
items.why: You would lead the national team assessing immunological veterinary medicine applications, a head level role where your authority background counts, though it asks for business fluent German.

items.title: Senior Associate - Regulatory CMC, Biocides/Pesticides/Topicals/Collars (m/f/d)
items.location: Monheim am Rhein or Kiel, Germany
items.why: It combines veterinary medicines and biocides regulatory work at an animal health company in Germany, matching both halves of your background.

items.title: Advisor – Global Regulatory Affairs CMC Biologicals
items.why: A senior global regulatory role for veterinary vaccines in Germany that values deep knowledge of EU veterinary legislation.

items.title: Product Registration Senior Specialist (gn)
items.why: Global registration of feed additives that can be done fully remote and only requires English, a direct use of your feed additive experience.

items.title: Registration Manager / Regulatory Affairs Manager (m/w/d) Petfood
items.why: A manager level animal nutrition registration role under feed and veterinary law with hybrid work, though it is petfood and a two year fixed term contract.

items.title: Scientific Officer (Referral Procedure CVMP)
items.why: You would run CVMP referrals for veterinary medicines at the EU agency, a direct step up from national authority work, but the deadline is 27 October and it means moving to Amsterdam.

items.title: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Officer
items.why: Veterinary medicine is a named degree for this EU role on antimicrobial sales and use under the veterinary medicines regulation, though it also asks for Power BI or R skills and closes on 29 October.
